reason: B is the stronger proposal because it uses a lower Al substitution level to directly address the known ductility loss at Al0.4, defines quantitative mechanical-property thresholds, and tests a composition series against the as-cast baseline at both room temperature and ~1000 °C. Its claimed 10–15% density reduction from replacing only 25–30% of the Hf is likely overestimated, but the intervention and falsification experiment are still more specific and informative than A’s.
